intro: Strategic Execution Deck: COO/BD Operational Roadmap

Objective: A systematic blueprint to scale Liivrr through five hyper-efficient phases. Each step outlines the strategic objective (What), the business rationale (Why), and the precise execution path (How) to hit our core milestone of 1,000 active users and 50 merchant tenants (restaurants & event organizers) by December 2026.

phases.title: Slide 1: Phase 1 (Days 1–15) — Infrastructure & Microgrant Capture
phases.what: Establish a secure, functional blockchain backend on the Arc Mainnet, integrate Circle’s Programmable Wallets, and secure baseline ecosystem validation.
phases.why: Deploying an asset early on mainnet removes technical risks. Capturing immediate micro-capital signals developer activity to the foundation, fast-tracking our review status for larger, six-figure institutional grants needed to support our Q4 2026 target metrics.
actions: • Deploy Core Contracts: Write and deploy a lightweight, gas-optimized ticketing smart contract natively onto the Arc Mainnet.
• Embed Web3 Wallets: Initialize Circle's Programmable Wallets SDK within the Liivrr mobile client to handle frictionless, gasless user account generation.
• Trigger Micro-Funding: Submit the live Mainnet GitHub repository to the Arc Microgrants Program to unlock an immediate $500 USDC payout.
• Offset Infrastructure Overhead: Apply to the Circle Credits Program to secure $1,000 in operational credits, completely subsidizing early developer database hosting costs.

phases.title: Slide 2: Phase 2 (Days 16–30) — Institutional Grant Acquisition
phases.what: Secure up to $100,000 USDC in non-dilutive, milestone-based capital from Circle and deep-tier ecosystem backing from the Arc Builders Fund.
phases.why: To extend our engineering and marketing runway without sacrificing company equity. Aligning our platform with the core utility goals of Arc and Circle gives us access to elite developer support and direct intros to top-tier Web3 venture capital firms.
actions: • Submit Circle Developer Grant: Compile and submit our product roadmap to the Circle Grant portal, explicitly highlighting how Liivrr acts as a high-velocity consumer vehicle for USDC microtransactions via event ticketing.

• Position for Agentic Commerce: Frame our technical proposal around the Arc Builders Fund parameters, positioning Liivrr’s conversational AI bots as a premier use case for automated onchain commerce.
• Pitch Milestone Targets: Align our grant disbursement schedule directly with our upcoming December 2026 goals:
• Milestone 1: Disbursement upon successfully onboarding our first 25 event/restaurant tenants.
• Milestone 2: Disbursement upon scaling to 1,000 active user wallets and completing 50 total tenant integrations by December 2026.

phases.title: Slide 3: Phase 3 (Days 31–45) — Collegiate Pilot & Tenant Acquisition Run
phases.what: Launch a hyper-dense, high-retention user acquisition pilot across target campus clusters, aggressively onboarding 50 local restaurant and event tenants alongside a core base of 1,000 active users by December 2026.
phases.why: Consumer social apps thrive on dense, localized network effects. Bringing local restaurants and student event organizers onto the platform as tenants provides the immediate inventory required to attract and retain our 1,000-user baseline.
actions: • Onboard the 50 Tenants: Deploy a specialized BD field team to pitch local restaurants and event curators. Offer them zero platform fees for their first 3 months and free AI-driven attendance forecasting to secure their tenant placement.
• Deploy Campus Ambassadors: Recruit and onboard influential student organizers at target universities to lock down exclusive ticketing rights for campus parties, Greek life, and club events.

• Engage the Viral Loop: Activate peer-to-peer user loops by programmatically rewarding students with $LIIVRR tokens when they invite friends into private event chat rooms, ensuring we cross the 1,000 active user threshold before December 2026.

phases.title: Slide 4: Phase 4 (Days 46–60) — Autonomous AI Event Concierge
phases.what: Integrate personalized, conversational AI agents into user profiles that proactively plan nights out and complete end-to-end event/restaurant bookings.
phases.why: Static map interfaces and calendar feeds are commoditized. Transitioning the user experience into an intelligent, conversational stream creates a massive competitive advantage over legacy platforms like Luma or Resident Advisor, driving up interaction frequency among our 1,000 users.
actions: • Deploy Localized LLM Agents: Integrate custom AI planning agents into the user profile backend that analyze user preferences, calendar data, and real-time physical locations.

• Activate Conversational Booking: Enable full natural-language ticket purchasing and restaurant reservations. Users text the chat interface ("Find an underground rave or a highly-rated dinner spot for my group tonight under $30"), and the agent automatically parses the map database, confirms space, and processes payment.

• Launch Tenant Dashboards: Open a basic predictive analytics dashboard for our 50 verified restaurant and event tenants, allowing them to optimize their drink inventory, table layouts, and staff schedules based on incoming AI-agent booking flows.

phases.title: Slide 5: Phase 5 (December 2026+) — Native Monetization & Flywheel Optimization
phases.what: Turn on high-margin, scalable platform revenue streams across both consumer-facing and B2B layers once the 1,000 user and 50 tenant milestones are fully cemented.
phases.why: To move away from relying on grants and transition into a highly profitable, self-sustaining ecosystem where user activity directly drives consistent revenue and scales our tenant network further into 2027.
actions: • Program Conversational Ad Streams: Deploy hyper-local ad placements directly within the AI concierge chat interface (e.g., if a user tells their agent they are going to one of our 50 partner restaurants, local rideshare apps bid in real-time to offer a ride coupon).
• Sell Premium Map Real-Estate: Allow our 50 verified tenants to purchase sponsored pin-drops and real-time live map highlights to drive foot traffic during peak hours.

• Enforce Platform Protocol Fees: Programmatically collect a minor platform processing fee on all primary ticket sales, restaurant booking deposits, and secure, peer-to-peer secondary market ticket transfers.
